values.text: Welcome to The Navigator. This month, two new rules make it harder to ship goods without knowing exactly where they came from. Here’s what changed and what it means for your team.
Customs wants to see further into your supply chain

A proposal published this month would require importers to share more detail about suppliers, and earlier. Comments are open until 30 November.

The detail matters more than the date: it asks for records most teams don’t keep today.

The rules moving this month, and what they mean for keeping goods moving:

•  Origin data: new fields required on import filings from January.
•  Supplier lists: a public register opens for comment in December.
•  Spot checks: more random inspections at the three busiest ports.
